gate_questions.2_history_check: exp-20260523-013 tested strong-leadership/cool-risk top-up and failed Gate 4. This is the distinct neutral-leadership/cool-risk state suggested by the entry-day attribution breadth, not a scalar retry on the same vector cell.

hypothesis: A compressed entry-day canonical state vector may identify already-qualified core signals where leadership is neutral while portfolio/theme/regime risk heat is still cool. Those signals may deserve a small cap-aware risk top-up without changing entry, exit, ranking, universe, news, or LLM logic.
known_risks: Moderate multiple-testing risk because the clue came from a fresh read-only attribution surface.
The vector is production-computable but not yet promoted as a strategy input.
If accepted, production parity requires shared implementation before orders change.

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move canonical vector state exposure and top-up into shared daily context/risk/portfolio modules with parity tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol before production use.
